text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: This is a research article (not a review) that explicitly models land use change for the entire Chinese mainland (national scale). It uses the LANDSCAPE cellular automata model to simulate future land use maps for 2015–2030 under multiple scenarios (cropland quantity and quality balance at four administrative scales). The study includes quantitative evaluation of model accuracy (Kappa Simulation) and produces spatially explicit LULC projections. The primary focus is on LULC prediction/simulation to assess impacts of cropland protection policies on habitat quality. Multiple future scenarios are quantitatively compared, and spatial modeling with accuracy metrics is reported. Therefore, it meets all core inclusion criteria and none of the exclusion criteria.)
